style: Palette of jade mint green, signal yellow and soft lilac accents over deep green-slate shadows. Clean, readable shapes like a polished top-down video game.

images.prompt: High aerial view looking almost straight down on a sunlit frontier region, a wide landscape filling the entire frame from edge to edge: in the upper middle a small cozy village of colour-coded prefab houses with gardens and a little square; a river winds across the frame past patches of forest and farmland; on the right a colossal tracked mobile fortress the size of a town block crawls across a plain, its flat roof covered in turrets, hangar hatches and tiny walkways; four airships fly in a diamond formation overhead, casting long soft shadows on the fields; at the top edge the land meets a calm sea with thin drifting clouds. A whole living world seen from above, inviting and calm. The lower left of the image is quiet green meadow with nothing in it. No text, lettering or signatures anywhere.

Top-down view looking straight down, like a twin-stick video game screenshot, into a burning apartment interior seen without its roof: a single firefighter in a bright yellow and jade protective suit with a breathing mask sprays a wide white foam jet from a hose at flames creeping across a sofa, a rug and a wooden floor; soft grey smoke drifts over part of the room; a fallen ceiling beam and scattered chairs and boxes lie on the floor; through an open doorway in the wall, a neighbouring room where a frightened cat hides under a table. The walls are drawn from above as thick clean lines, so the room layout reads clearly. No text, HUD, lettering or signatures anywhere.

Top-down view looking straight down onto a wide dusty plain: in the centre a colossal six-tracked mobile base vehicle with its roof cut away as a clean cutaway, revealing a grid of square interior rooms: a bridge with consoles, a reactor room with a glowing core, crew quarters with bunks, a vehicle bay holding a small tank, corridors and sliding doors, tiny crew members walking inside. Around it on the plain, three smaller armored hover vehicles circle and fire glowing yellow shots at its outer hull, and one shot has punched down into a single interior room, which flashes with sparks. A clean, readable cutaway like a technical illustration. No text, labels, lettering or signatures anywhere.

Tall portrait cover illustration showing one continuous zoom from small to vast, stacked from bottom to top: at the bottom, seen from above, a small figure in a jade and yellow jumpsuit standing in a cozy village square; above that the village opens into a region of forests and rivers with a huge tracked mobile fortress and a formation of airships; above that the land curves away into a green and blue planet seen from orbit, ringed by small space stations; at the top a star system with a bright star, a ringed gas giant, convoys of tiny ships and a swirling galaxy beyond. Calm open sky at the very top. Inviting and full of wonder. No text, lettering, title or signatures anywhere.

Extremely wide zoomed-out space vista seen from high above a star system, like a painting rather than a map: a bright yellow-white star with a glowing corona in the centre, small hot rocky planets close to it, a green and blue habitable planet with the tiny lights of cities and a small moon, a scattered asteroid belt, a ringed gas giant, a large glowing ring-shaped gate structure, and convoys of tiny ships travelling between the worlds. Far beyond, along the very edge of the frame, a dim colossal wall of swirling dark violet storm clouds marks the edge of the universe. Calm, vast and at rest. No orbit lines, no grid, no diagram, no labels. No text, lettering, names or signatures anywhere.
